# The Neroid Sector
## Under Construction This page is still being written.
The [bold]Neroid Sector[/bold] is a frontier region of the Outer Veil, in [textlink="Three World Empire" link="CMUGuideLoreTWE"] (TWE) space, where the interests of every great power meet. Its colonies are rich in resources but scattered, poorly protected and far from help, and nobody holds it outright.
